core_claims.name: Par / Pars / parRefl
core_claims.scope: Unrestricted parallel reduction and its finite reflexive-transitive closure, including parallel application, beta contraction and lambda bodies; structural reflexivity for every scoped term.

core_claims.name: parRename / parSubst / parBeta
core_claims.scope: Parallel reduction preserved by arbitrary renaming and by simultaneous pointwise parallel-related substitutions, with the single-beta substitution corollary.

core_claims.name: develop / parTriangle / parDiamond
core_claims.scope: Complete development of any source term; every parallel reduct further parallel-reduces to that development, yielding a genuine diamond without an assumption of termination.

core_claims.name: stepPar / stepsPars / parSteps / parsSteps
core_claims.scope: Ordinary full beta finite reachability and parallel finite reachability are mutually constructively convertible. A parallel round is serialized into a finite ordinary path, not equated with one ordinary step.

core_claims.name: strip / parsConfluent / confluence
core_claims.scope: For every scope and every pair of finite full beta paths from one source, construct a common reduct and both joining paths. No strategy restriction, typing premise or normalization premise.

core_claims.name: Convertible / churchRosser
core_claims.scope: For every finite chain of forward/backward full beta edges, construct a common forward reduct of its endpoints.

core_claims.name: normalPath / normalUnique
core_claims.scope: Two irreducible endpoints reachable from the same source are syntactically equal. Both reachability and normality premises are explicit; normal-form existence is not claimed.

deviations: The proof uses the same parallel-reduction/complete-development/strip construction with Fin scopes and pointwise substitution algebra.
Finite zigzag convertibility and reachable normal-form uniqueness are additional explicit corollaries; no deterministic restriction replaces full beta confluence.

verification.compiler: Idris2 0.8.0 from the pinned Nix environment
